newsitem.title: USA: Petrolite, largest shareholder set to explore sale.
newsitem.headline: Petrolite, largest shareholder set to explore sale.

text.p: Petrolite Corp said Friday it had agreed with Wm. S. Barnickle & Co, its largest shareholder, to explore a sale or merger of the specialty chemical company.
The two firms also agreed to dismiss litigation pending in Delaware, Petrolite said.

Under a memorandum of understanding signed late Wednesday, a special committee of Petrolite's board will be in charge of the sale process, with two Barnickle representatives participating but not voting.
Petrolite's financial adviser Goldman, Sachs & Co and Barnickle's adviser Morgan, Stanley & Co will work on one process to sell the company, Petrolite said.
Barnickle has agreed to a stand-still on any consent solicitation for 90 days, Petrolite said.
Earlier this month a group of shareholders including Barnickle said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission that it was seeking the removal of Petrolite's board.

On November 15 Petrolite said it had rejected as inadequate two expressions of interest in the company -- one that indicated a value of at least $40 a share and another in the range of $40 to $44 a share.
